name: Divinópolis

queries.query: Divinopolis MG official cadastral parcel map prefeitura cadastro imobiliario geospatial portal
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Prefeitura de Divinópolis Geoportal/DiviGeo as the municipal territorial-management IDE, with cadastral cartographic archive, geoservices, downloads, and an interactive map. The municipal news page documents an urban geoprocessing survey with 111,317 georeferenced lots. No anonymous parcel feature response was qualified.

queries.query: Divinópolis MG mapa de lotes cadastro imobiliário oficial geoprocessamento parcela
queries.result: Portuguese first-party discovery confirmed the municipal Geoportal and the municipal Cadastro Imobiliário/Secretaria Municipal de Fazenda as local custodians. The official portal exposes a cadastral map download and tutorials including coordinate-based property consultation, but the current map configuration endpoint requires GeoWise authentication. No safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

registryCustodian.name: Prefeitura de Divinópolis — Cadastro Imobiliário / Geoportal (DiviGeo)
registryCustodian.scope: Municipal cadastral and territorial-management custodian; official municipal reporting describes georeferenced urban lots and the Geoportal exposes cadastral cartography and geoservice/download entry points.

service.name: Divinópolis Geoportal / DiviGeo municipal IDE
service.viewerConfiguration: The current public React bundle was inspected. It calls https://geo.divinopolis.mg.gov.br/api/geoportal/downloads and geowise/mapa/get_map_by_target?target=geoportal; the latter is used to populate the interactive map and to derive WMS/WFS download URLs from server-provided layer metadata. Layer names, parcel schema, native identity field, and CRS were not exposed without the authenticated map response.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Anonymous Geoportal HTML loaded. It is a JavaScript application and exposed the current bundle paths for inspection.

Current viewer JavaScript loaded. It identified the public downloads endpoint and the GeoWise map-configuration request, including client logic that would build WFS/WMS download URLs from server-provided layer metadata.

Anonymous JSON response returned municipal downloads, including a cadastral map PDF and tutorials for coordinate-based property consultation. No parcel vector features, stable parcel IDs, or geometry were returned.
Anonymous request redirected to /geowise/login; no map layer metadata, WFS/WMS source, schema, CRS, or feature response obtained. No login, credentials, private token, or bypass was attempted.
Login wall rendered. Research stopped at the public boundary; no authentication was attempted.
